parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The start date of the call, in the format of **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of resources to return. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 100. The number of returned results may be less than the specified value but never exceeds it.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to provide this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, obtain the token from the returned results.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Limits the returned resource names to those that start with the specified prefix.

parameters.name: qualifier
parameters.description: The version ID or alias of the service.

parameters.name: startKey
parameters.description: Specifies that results are returned starting from the first entry that is alphabetically equal to or after startKey.
